title: What If the World Had to Delete One Second From Time?

scenes.text: What if the world had to delete one second? Clocks have only ever added them.
Atomic clocks never slow down, but Earth's spin does, so 27 leap seconds were added between 1972 and 2016.
Now Earth is spinning slightly faster, and a Nature study predicted a second may need removing around 2029.
Melting polar ice has slowed the spin and delayed that by about three years. Without it, the date would be 2026.
In 2012 leap second errors hit Reddit, Linux and Qantas. Software is built to add time, not subtract it.
In 2022 timekeepers agreed to change the rules from the 2030s. One missing second could be the last one that matters.

description:
What if the world had to subtract a second for the first time?
A Nature study predicted it could happen around 2029, because Earth's spin is speeding up.
